goals.objective: Make llama-swap the sole owner of the Qwen model lifecycle with reliable on-demand swap (co-residency explicitly dropped), clear every residue left by the two reverts in both the easyllama repo and the dotfiles repo, and prove end-to-end that 127.0.0.1:8080 serves chat/embeddings/rerank and that Hindsight's stalled backlog resumes draining. Success is observable when: (a) grep evidence shows no co-residency/publish/warm-service residue and `ruff` + `pytest` are green in /mnt/LIBRARY/llamacpp; (b) the healthCheckTimeout/sendLoadingState claim in commit e24483b is either truly implemented or corrected, with documented before/after client-visible behaviour for a deliberately failing route; (c) with the stack up via run.sh --mode qwen, POST /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings (dim 1024) and /v1/rerank (results present) each return HTTP 200 and llama-swap starts/evicts the aux group on demand with one resident group at a time, surviving a second chat restart; (d) Hindsight reports health ready and its pending count declines measurably over a >=10-minute window with zero new embedding/rerank errors and no openai_responses_llm retry storms — the measured pending delta is reported; (e) both repos are committed, pushed, and `git status` clean with local HEAD == origin/main, and the live config/config.qwen.yml mirrors config/config.qwen.yml.example. Boundaries — In scope: easyllama qwen mode (config/config.qwen.yml[.example], easyllama/helpers/orchestrator.py, docs/CHANGELOG), the dotfiles deployment source at /mnt/PROJECTS/repos/dotfiles (server.env.tmpl, easyllama.service.tmpl, scripts/easyllama.py, templates/manifest.json, .github/context docs), and the live local stack plus Hindsight queue. Out of scope: other modes (nvfp, glm5.3-flash, lucebox, turboquant, spiritbuun), dotfiles services unrelated to easyllama/Hindsight, upstream llama-swap/vLLM/llama.cpp code, and reviving the co-residency or host-loopback-publishing designs. Constraints — llama-swap must remain the only model-lifecycle owner: no publish flags, no keep-awake/warm service, no external /run holder; one resident group at a time is the accepted steady state; do NOT reduce the chat's 128K context or change quantization (co-residency is dropped, not engineered); no git history rewrite — add new commits on top of e3843b1/7bcdc86/3a95906/3371eac; regenerate templates/manifest.json via the dotfiles renderer rather than hand-editing hashes; Hindsight embeddings and rerank must point at the local proxy 127.0.0.1:8080, not the 20128 direct-wiring path; do not commit secrets. Verification contract — Run `ruff` and `python -m pytest` in /mnt/LIBRARY/llamacpp with 0 failures; grep both repos for co-residency/publish/warm-service residue and paste the results; capture live curl status codes and response shapes for all three routes plus /running snapshots and the llama-swap log lines showing start/health-check/eviction; record a before/after of the client-visible behaviour for a deliberately failing route; compute and report the Hindsight pending delta across the >=10-minute window; confirm both repos' `git status` clean and HEAD == origin/main. If blocked — stop and ask the user.

decision.nextAction: Continue pursuing the goal, then verify and complete it when satisfied.
